title: Recursive counting of small boxes nested together
goal: defines the end condition of the recursion and continues the calculation with smaller inputs.
summary: activity materials are stored in a set of boxes. The outermost layer is box No. n, and inside are boxes No. n-1 to No. 1. Each box contains materials equal to the number.
tasks: Completes countBoxes(n), recursively counting the total number of materials from n to 1.
n is an integer from 0 to 40. The total is 0 when there are no boxes.

example.note: The recursive function needs a situation that can return directly, and other branches call themselves again after narrowing the problem.

hint: ends when n is 0. Otherwise add n to the return value of countBoxes(n - 1).
